name: openzoo
description: Local x402-paying proxy + MCP server for openzoo.fun — point any OpenAI-compatible harness (Cursor, Claude Code, aider, SDKs) at localhost and it pays per call from a local burner wallet. Solana and Base rails live; Robinhood experimental. `openzoo build|deploy|serve|hub|runtime` transmute a Vercel-shaped app (Next.js / Vite + /api) into Solana accounts on the shared zoo-vm Pinocchio runtime (~0.05 SOL a site) or a dedicated program, mainnet.
